info.name: Vendor API V3 apps customHostnames API

items.docs:
Add a new custom hostname for a specific app and service (registry, proxy, download portal, or replicated app).

Required RBAC Policy: kots/app/[:appid]/customhostname/create

Remove a custom hostname from a specific app and service (registry, proxy, download portal, or replicated app).

Required RBAC Policy: kots/app/[:appid]/customhostname/delete

Set the default custom hostname for a specific app and service (registry, proxy, download portal, or replicated app).
The default hostname is used when no other custom hostname is specified for a channel.

Required RBAC Policy: kots/app/[:appid]/customhostname/default/set

Remove the default custom hostname for a specific app and service (registry, proxy, download portal, or replicated app).
After unsetting, the system will fall back to the replicated hostname for that service if a custom hostname is not set for a channel.

Required RBAC Policy: kots/app/[:appid]/customhostname/default/unset

info.name: List custom hostnames for an app.

items.docs:
Return all custom hostnames configured for the specified app, grouped by service (registry, proxy, download portal, replicated app).

Required RBAC Policy: kots/app/[:appid]/customhostname/list
